name: text-rewrite
title: Text Rewrite
description: A line that writes itself a word at a time, comes forward and gets selected — then its opening is swept away by a clip that cuts letters in half as it passes, and a new ending is written on while the line slides to its new centre. The mark rides the sweeping edge throughout.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/text/text-rewrite?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.
